title: Early Survival and Workshop
purpose: Secure a compact workshop and gather the material families needed for electrification.
automation_paths: Manual mining is acceptable only at this opening scale.
optimization_opportunities: Experienced players consolidate mining trips and build only durable workshop infrastructure.
infrastructure_reuse: The workshop, furnaces, and Iron Chests become the intake area for the electrical factory.

milestones.title: Industrial Starter Materials
final_validation: Obtain coal, iron, copper, tin, and rubber.

milestones.title: Copper or Iron Storage
final_validation: Build either a Copper Chest or an Iron Chest and keep it in your inventory long enough for the questbook to recognize it.

milestones.title: Workshop Defense
final_validation: Obtain a basic defensive weapon and ammunition.

milestones.title: Manual Production Area
final_validation: Arrange crafting, furnaces, storage, and safe lighting as a usable workshop.

milestones.title: Secure Workshop
final_validation: Maintain a lit, enclosed workshop and prepare the materials for an IC2 Generator.
